verdict.line: You win when you land W (Infernal Chains) before her Hallowed Mist is up and chain into Deathbringer Stance; you lose if you stand and static-trade into her Q cone and auto-passive procs.

brief.thesis: Aatrox holds the lane and solo-kill edge (49.2% win rate, 942 games) because his all-in is built to punish Gwen before she can wall herself off: landing W (Infernal Chains) drags her into melee range where her only real defensive tool, W (Hallowed Mist), can't save her since it only protects from enemies who stay outside it. If the mist is already up when you commit, or you let the fight turn into a slow poke exchange, her passive (A Thousand Cuts) and Q's true-damage center quietly outvalue you.

theirWindow.when: Right after she lands E (Skip 'n Slash)
theirWindow.what: For a few seconds she has bonus attack speed, range, and magic on-hit damage. Don't stand and trade through it — either disengage with E (Umbral Dash) or commit fully with Q before the window ends.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Hallowed Mist) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Open with W (Infernal Chains) at 825 range — she has no way to escape targeting outside the mist, so this is the moment to drag her in and chain Q, E, and an empowered Deathbringer Stance auto for the full combo.

powerCurve.note: No W yet, trades stay short and even
W online lets you force all-ins
R plus Eclipse spike, solo-kill edge

start.why: Runs at 50.4% over 752 games and backs the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this lane — you need the sustain and damage to actually press the W-engage window before she gets Hallowed Mist online.

boots.why: Measured at 50.9% over 609 games; her passive, E on-hit, and R are all magic damage, so the flat MR blunts the poke you take while closing in for your all-in.

core.why: The two-hit proc lines up with your Q-into-auto all-in combo and rewards you for engaging while her mist is down.
On-hit healing off Q's multiple swings keeps you ahead on HP through her passive's magic chip damage.
Converts her burst into damage over time so your passive and E sustain can outheal it across an extended skirmish; this path hits 64% over 50 games.

situational.when: if her magic burst starts threatening to one-shot you off a single all-in
if you want more ability haste to reset W (Infernal Chains) faster instead of the Sundered Sky path
if you need extra mobility to close the gap before she can E (Skip 'n Slash) away

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through extended trades and skirmishes, which matters because the fight tends to swing in your favor the longer it drags on once you've landed your engage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs 51.2% over the largest sample and matches the measured solo-kill advantage — you're meant to end fights here, not just survive them.

playing.title: Engage before her mist is up
playing.detail: Land W (Infernal Chains) at 825 range while Hallowed Mist is on cooldown. Once she's inside the mist, pulling her out with W no longer matters — she's already untargetable from outside it.

playing.title: Stay on her after her dash
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash only moves her 400 range. Close back in immediately with E (Umbral Dash) rather than letting her kite with the attack speed and range bonus she gains after it lands.

playing.title: Trade on Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Watch your passive icon and initiate auto-trades the instant it's charged — the bonus magic damage plus the healing tilts short exchanges hard in your favor.

playing.title: Don't trade through her post-E window
playing.detail: For a few seconds after Skip 'n Slash connects she has extra attack speed, range, and magic on-hit. Either disengage or go all-in during it; standing and matching autos loses that exchange.

playing.title: Hold E for the all-in
playing.detail: Umbral Dash only heals you when it damages a champion, so save it for initiating or finishing a fight at level 3+ rather than burning it on wave clear.

playing.title: Close distance, don't poke
playing.detail: Her Q is a short cone capped at 450 range with true damage in the center. Standing just outside that range between trades denies her the free true-damage tick.

playing.title: Use R to finish, not to open
playing.detail: World Ender's AD, healing, and move speed are for extending a fight you're already winning — pop it once you're in range to close out the skirmish, not from max range to start one.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the reading of cooldown windows, trade timing, and the Hallowed Mist interaction is my own tactical analysis.
